description: Elementary already-shellable convex 4-dimensional bipyramid triangulation; not a conjecturally difficult input.
convexity_certificate: Both apex projections equal the average of the four ridge vertices. Every convex combination with apex weights a,b can replace min(a,b) times each apex by 2 min(a,b) times this ridge average, leaving at most one apex with positive weight. Hence the convex hull equals the union of the two simplices. Their intersection is exactly the ridge, as their other points lie on opposite sides of x4=0.
